title: Take the question
process: The economies, years and measures in the question are read using code, and the reading is shown so the user can correct it.
tasks: Ask the question;Choose the use mode and the reply length;Read the economies, years and measures in the question;Confirm or correct that reading

title: Route
process: The question is sent, using code, to the cheapest route that can answer it: a series title, a calculation, passages, or a person.
tasks: Route the question;Ask the user to clarify a vague question;Escalate a question beyond the data

title: Fetch evidence
process: Passages the use mode does not allow are removed, the matching passages are found, and the figures are calculated from the data, all using code.
tasks: Keep only the passages the use mode allows;Find the passages that match the question;Calculate the figures

title: Assemble context
process: The template part is filled using code with figures, comparisons and definitions, and is put in the prompt with the chosen passages.

title: Generate with citations
process: The explanation is the language model's output: a few sentences, each ending with the id of the passage it cites.
tasks: Answer a definition question from passages;Explain the figures

title: Check, record, escalate
process: Each sentence is checked using code; the explanation is retried once or dropped, every step is recorded, and questions beyond the data are passed to a person.
tasks: Check each sentence of the explanation;Retry once, or drop the explanation;Record each step in the trace;Answer an escalated question
